title: Everettian Probability in Lean: Refinement-Invariant Rational Expectation
description: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of a decision-theoretic layer for finite-dimensional Everettian quantum mechanics. The archived release formalizes acts, refinement invariance, rational expectation, Born calibration, typed premise audits, explicit weight-level, decision-level, and projection-measure-level countermodels, a uniform relative-necessity campaign for exposed Born-calibration premises, two formulation-minimality results, and a dimension-two noninjective boundary witness for the one-directional Uhlhorn interface. It does not derive rationality from unitary dynamics alone. This record archives GitHub tag v2.4.0-journal-audit. Quantum Foundations remains pinned to tag v1.3.1-journal-audit at commit f773ed5694c610af055b82427da27a69d528b776, and the transitive Gleason dependency remains pinned to tag v1.1.0-journal-audit at commit 5c5bc40d2e4a31a0d1b3112fcc9a3e92b2000ec5.
